expectations.text: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many files up front
expectations.evidence: "Don't pre-split on reflex. You don't need csv-headers.ts, csv-rows.ts, csv-escape.ts on day one." Targets 5-6 files total; "a cohesive 150-line file beats three 50-line ones."

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
expectations.evidence: "Co-locate the client polling logic in a use-export.ts hook — don't split start-vs-poll." Orchestration kept in one export-job.ts rather than scattered across routes.

expectations.text: Recommends an abstraction (function/module) over bare file splits
expectations.evidence: "Prefer an abstraction over a new file whenever you can — it actually reduces the context needed." useExport() hook exposing { start, status, progress, downloadUrl }; "reach for a well-named internal helper function before you reach for a new file."

expectations.text: Mentions a ~300-line threshold (or 'a few hundred lines') as the split trigger
expectations.evidence: "Split it only if it crosses a few hundred lines or starts covering genuinely separate formats."
